welcome.tagline: Adventures where math changes the story.
welcome.mascot: Hi there! Ready for a new story?

picker.needAdultTitle: A grown-up needs to log in first
picker.needAdultText: To play, a grown-up logs in once on this device and creates your profile. After that you can play on your own.
picker.demoPins: Demo mode: the Zoé profile opens with the code 1234. Max does not have a parent's permission yet. Profiles you create keep the code you choose.
picker.none: No profile yet. Ask a grown-up to create one.

home.title: Home
home.growth: This week: {now} chapters. The week before: {before}. You are getting better!

tour.welcome: Here, math decides what happens to the hero. Every answer changes the story.
tour.continue: Tap this card to continue your story.
tour.streak: Each day you finish a chapter, your flame grows.
tour.worlds: Pick the world you love: nature, space, cooking and more.

journey.unknownWorld: This world does not exist. Go back and pick a world.

quest.title: Daily quest
quest.intro: One chapter to find things you already learned, in a brand new story.

story.pauseText: Your story is waiting. You can pick up exactly here.

noVoice.title: No voice to read aloud
noVoice.description: This device has no voice in this language. The story stays written on screen.

exit.label: Leave the game
exit.title: Leave this story?
exit.text: Your story will be put away. You can start another one whenever you like.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.intro: Pick a challenge, take it on by playing, and win a card that is all yours.

parentGate.title: Grown-ups only
parentGate.description: Enter the account password to leave play mode.
parentGate.wrong: That password does not match. Try again.
parentGate.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.

errors.passwordShort: The password needs at least 10 characters.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Log in instead.
errors.wrongCredentials: Wrong email or password. Check and try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: We could not continue right now. Try again in a moment.

home.title: My children
home.empty: Add a profile to start the adventure.

childForm.title: New child

childForm.nameHint: No last name. It is only used in the story.
childForm.pinSwitch: Protect the profile with a code
childForm.pinHint: A 4-digit code to enter this profile.

errors.name: Enter a first name or nickname.

consent.title: Parental permission
consent.whatTitle: What Numerix does with the data

points.collect: We keep the first name, grade and answers to questions so stories can adapt.
points.noPhoto: No photos, no last names, no location.
points.noAds: No ads and no third-party trackers.
points.control: You can export or erase your child's data at any time.

consent.agree: I have read this and allow my child to play.

growth.title: Their growth

settings.title: Settings
settings.goalOption: {count, plural, one {# chapter a day} other {# chapters a day}}
settings.readAloudHint: Stories are read aloud if the device has a voice in this language.
settings.worldsHint: At least one world must stay on.

confirm.title: Delete this profile?
confirm.description: This cannot be undone. Stories, progress and cards will be erased.

report.title: Weekly report
report.growthLine: {now} chapters finished, against {before} the week before.

account.title: Account and preferences
account.guideHint: Show the welcome tips again for all profiles.

pwa.updateText: Reload to get the latest version.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: This screen is for a grown-up.

consent_missing.title: A grown-up needs to say yes first
consent_missing.description: Ask a parent to accept in the parent area.

daily_limit_reached.title: That's enough for today
daily_limit_reached.description: See you tomorrow for the next part of the story.

session_active.title: A chapter is already in progress
session_active.description: Resume it or start a new chapter.

session_paused.title: The chapter is paused
session_paused.description: Resume it to continue the story.

session_completed.title: This chapter is finished
session_completed.description: Go back to your path to choose what comes next.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.description: This item no longer exists. Go back home.

rate_limited.title: Easy does it
rate_limited.description: Wait a moment, then try again.

internal_error.title: Something went wrong on our side
internal_error.description: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, let us know.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.description: Try again. If it keeps happening, let us know.

sound.title: Sound could not start
sound.description: The game goes on without sound. Check the device volume.

narrationFailed.title: The story could not load
narrationFailed.description: Tap Try again to start it over.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: You can look at your path and your cards. To play, reconnect.

device_offline.title: Your device is offline
device_offline.description: Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again. The problem is your connection.

server_unreachable.title: We cannot reach Numerix
server_unreachable.description: Your device says it is online, but Numerix does not answer. If other sites work, the problem is on our side. If not, check your connection.

backend_unreachable.title: This one is on us
backend_unreachable.description: Our servers are not answering right now. It is not your connection. Try again in a moment.

backend_timeout.title: Our servers are too slow
backend_timeout.description: It is not your connection. Try again in a moment.

request_failed.title: The request did not go through
request_failed.description: Your connection and our servers both answer, but this request failed. Try again.

chapterComplete.congrats: What a story! You moved the adventure forward.

narrationText.loading: The story is on its way
narrationText.slow: The story is taking a moment.
narrationText.fallback: This part of the story is told in a short version.

questCard.title: Daily quest
questCard.available: A few old stories could use your help.
questCard.unavailable: Nothing to revisit today. Enjoy your day!
questCard.completed: Quest done. See you tomorrow for more!

streak_extended.title: The flame grows
streak_extended.detail: {count, plural, one {# story day in a row} other {# story days in a row}}

skill_mastered.title: New power
skill_mastered.detail: You have mastered this step of the path.

daily_goal_met.title: Today's goal reached
daily_goal_met.detail: Well done, that's it for today.

welcomeGift.title: A gift is waiting for you
welcomeGift.hint: Tap the gift to open it.
